title: Tony Jackson and the district
summary: He remembers Tony Jackson as a fine pianist who played in the district; he himself never worked a district house regularly.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Did you ever hear a piano player called Tony Jackson when you were a kid?
Yeah. Yeah, I remember Tony Jackson.
Tony Jackson was a good piano player. Yeah, Tony Jackson was a good piano player. In fact, Tony Jackson was the only piano player I would sing. The first one I would sing when he played.
Some people tell me he used to work in the district too.
Yeah, he played all around the district and everywhere. Tony Jackson. Did you ever work
in the district in any of these playing piano in any of those houses?

No, I played around a whole lot of like Pete Lala's in different places around there. I played around in different places but I wasn't on no side of them. Just go around and different people playing. Now, around in all in that Vicarae up there I played many places I played in.
